name: @pipeworx/mcp-klaviyo

tools.name: klaviyo_list_profiles
tools.description: Search contacts by email, name, or custom attributes. Returns profile IDs, emails, names, and properties with pagination support.

filter.description: Filter string in Klaviyo filter syntax (e.g., "equals(email,\"user@example.com\")")

page_size.description: Number of profiles per page (default 20, max 100)

tools.name: klaviyo_get_profile
tools.description: Get a contact's full profile by ID. Returns email, name, phone, custom properties, list memberships, and subscription status.

tools.name: klaviyo_list_lists
tools.description: Get all email lists in your account. Returns list IDs, names, subscriber counts, and creation dates.

tools.name: klaviyo_list_campaigns
tools.description: Search campaigns by status (draft, scheduled, sent). Returns campaign IDs, names, status, send dates, and performance metrics.

tools.name: klaviyo_get_campaign
tools.description: Get a campaign's full details by ID. Returns name, status, subject line, recipient list, performance stats, and send history.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-klaviyo forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the klaviyo pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
